cases.question: Create a new user with email newanalyst@company.com and display name 'New Analyst', then confirm they were created successfully.
cases.ground_truth: User created with correct email, displayName, and active: true. If the user already exists from a prior run, a follow-up lookup confirms the existing user has the exact requested email, displayName, and active state.
expected_behavior: The agent creates the user with omni scim users-create, sending userName and displayName

After creating the user, or after receiving a conflict because the user already exists, the agent runs a verification step — either omni scim users-list with a filter or a get call — to confirm the user exists
The agent reports the user's ID or confirms active: true and the requested displayName from the verification response rather than assuming success from the create response alone

cases.question: Give the 'Analytics Team' group view access to the dashboard with identifier '{{EVAL_DASHBOARD_PERMISSIONS}}'.
cases.ground_truth: Document permissions updated so the Analytics Team group has view access. A verification step confirms the permission was applied.
expected_behavior: The agent finds the Analytics Team group ID before updating document access
The agent grants group access with omni documents add-permits or update-permits using userGroupIds and role: VIEWER
The agent verifies the change by reading back the document access list or effective permissions after setting them

cases.question: Set up a weekly email schedule for dashboard '{{EVAL_DASHBOARD_SCHEDULE}}' to send every Monday at 9am Pacific time as a PDF, and add team@company.com as a recipient.
cases.ground_truth: Schedule created with correct cron schedule, timezone, destination type, content, format, and recipient. Recipient and schedule settings are verified.
expected_behavior: The agent creates a schedule for the dashboard identifier using schedule: 0 9 ? * MON *, timezone: America/Los_Angeles, destinationType: email, content: dashboard, and format: pdf
The agent configures team@company.com as a recipient, either inline in the create body as an email string or with omni schedules add-recipients
The agent verifies the recipient with omni schedules recipients-get

The agent verifies schedule settings from omni schedules list or an equivalent schedule readback; if the schedule readback shape cannot be parsed, it reports that schedule setting verification was inconclusive instead of claiming full confirmation

cases.question: Set a user attribute 'region' to 'West Coast' for the user with email {{EVAL_EXISTING_USER}}.
cases.ground_truth: User attribute set via omni users set-attributes (or an equivalent SCIM update), and verification confirms the attribute was applied.
expected_behavior: The agent sets the attribute with omni users set-attributes, identifying the user by email or SCIM user ID, with --attr region="West Coast" (or --attr-json)
The agent verifies the attribute was set after the update
